current_brand3_watermelon_pipeline.weakness: mixes audited surface, adjacent domains, GitHub, Product Hunt, software listings, and unrelated Watermelon references before generation

local_evidence_packet_v0_expectation.strength: forces eligibility and review gates before prose
local_evidence_packet_v0_expectation.weakness: cannot discover missing sources as deeply as Deep Research without better upstream acquisition

deep_research_prism_trial.strength: discovers and separates useful entity/surface categories from one URL
deep_research_prism_trial.weakness: does not obey the evidence-packet output contract and turns evidence into narrative analysis

findings.summary: Deep Research found useful entity-separation and source-discovery material for Watermelon from one URL.
The model did not return parseable JSON and wrote a narrative audit despite explicit instructions.
The raw output used strong interpretive language such as high coherence, high vitality, and strategic deployment before structured evidence eligibility was settled.
The trial used 725,538 total tokens and estimated USD 2.505606 in model cost excluding search charges.

root_finding: Deep Research can improve discovery and entity separation, but in this prism mode it is not a reliable structured evidence packet compiler. It recreates Brand3's core failure if allowed to interpret before classification is locked.
recommended_next_step: Do not run more Deep Research trials immediately. Harden the local Evidence Packet v0 and existing Exa/Web acquisition order first. If Deep Research is tested again, require stricter schema enforcement or a narrower packet-only interface.
